desc: Parse p into pre, mid, suf by locating the two '*' indices; note edge cases where any part is empty.
Implement KMP matcher returning sorted list of all start indices of a pattern in s; run it for each part (empty part → all positions 0..n).
Chain with bisect_left: for each pre occurrence i, earliest mid start >= i+len(pre), then earliest suf start >= mid_start+len(mid); track min window length.
Handle p="**" (answer 0) and return -1 when no candidate exists.
Verify correctness on all four examples plus edge cases: overlapping occurrences, empty mid, suf at string end, pre at string start, no-match cases, and performance on n=1e5.
